features.fragment_buffering: Incomplete fragments are buffered; after the last fragment arrives, fragments are forwarded individually rather than reassembled for forwarding.
features.ttl_inheritance: Subsequent fragments are rewritten to use the TTL of fragment zero / first fragment.
features.duplicate_overlap_behavior: Duplicate or overlapping fragments cause the entire fragmentation state/queue to be discarded.
features.limit_behavior: 45 fragments accepted; a 46-fragment test is used as a discriminator because exceeding the limit discards the queue.
features.remote_localization: TTL-limited fragments and traceroute were used to identify links immediately before/after TSPU behavior.
features.rarity_control: The paper reports the 45-fragment limit as uncommon and uses multiple behaviors jointly rather than the limit alone.

tspu_high_specificity_reference_frozen_f.why_ooni_is_insufficient: OONI raw JSON preserves application/network-event timing and failure semantics but does not expose complete packet headers and crafted-fragment response behavior required to reproduce these discriminators.
